definition_en: an official record of the grades of a student, or a written copy of spoken words or of a document
core_image: 一张盖章的纸，把课堂上的话和分数一字不差地搬下来
scene: 申请研究生时，学校要求随材料提交盖章的学业记录。The university asked for an official transcript with the application.
sceneCN: 这里 transcript 是「成绩单」（第 1 个义项：学校出具的官方学业记录）；句意：申请时，学校要求随材料提交一份官方成绩单。

derivatives.zh: 把口头内容写成文字；抄录

senses.title: An official academic record
senses.definition: an official document listing the courses and grades of a student
senses.definitionCN: 列出学生所学课程与成绩的官方文件
senses.example: The graduate sent her transcript to the admissions office.
senses.exampleCN: 这位毕业生把成绩单寄给了招生办公室。
senses.why: Latin transcriptum is a thing written across, a copy; the school copy of a student record became the transcript.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 transcriptum 指「抄写过来的文本」，即副本；学校抄存的学生记录就成了成绩单。

senses.title: A written version of speech
senses.definition: a written copy of words that were spoken, such as an interview or a court hearing
senses.definitionCN: 把说出口的话写下来的文本，如访谈或庭审记录
senses.example: The lawyer read the transcript of the witness.
senses.exampleCN: 律师读了证人的证词记录。
senses.why: The copy sense narrows to speech written down word for word.
senses.whyCN: 「副本」的意思收窄到「把话一字不差写下来」，于是有了文字稿。

senses.title: A written copy of a document
senses.definition: a copy of a document written out from an original
senses.definitionCN: 依原件抄写而成的文件副本
senses.example: The archive keeps a transcript of the old charter.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保存着那份旧宪章的抄本。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a document written across from another.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项：从另一份文件「抄写过来」的文本。

senses.title: An RNA copy in biology
senses.definition: a piece of RNA made from a gene, which carries its message
senses.definitionCN: 由基因生成、携带其信息的一段核糖核酸
senses.example: The cell makes a transcript of the gene.
senses.exampleCN: 细胞为该基因生成一份转录本。
senses.why: Molecular biology borrows the copy image for the RNA copied from DNA.
senses.whyCN: 分子生物学借用「副本」的意象，指从脱氧核糖核酸抄录出的核糖核酸。

intro.en: Transcript joins Latin trans-, across, with scribere, to write; a transcript is writing carried across from a source.
intro.cn: transcript 由拉丁语 trans-（穿过、越过）与 scribere（写）组合；它的本义是「从某个来源抄写过来的文字」。

items.en: Trans means across, and scribere means to write.
items.cn: trans 意为穿过、越过，scribere 意为书写。

items.en: Scriptum names a thing that has been written.
Transcriptum names a copy written out from an original.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 transcriptum 指依原件抄出的副本。

items.en: Transcript names a written copy of a document.
items.cn: 十三世纪起，transcript 指文件的书面副本。

items.en: American colleges give the word its sense of an academic record.
items.cn: 十九世纪美国高校赋予该词「学业记录」的意思。

items.en: The word also names speech written down and an RNA copy.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词也指写下来的讲话与核糖核酸副本。

note.en: Transcript pairs trans- with scribere, next to transcribe and transcription, and it sits near the record words of school and court.
note.cn: transcript 把 trans- 与 scribere 配在一起，与 transcribe、transcription 同根，也与学校、法庭的记录类词相邻。

entries.definition: to write down words or copy a record
the act or product of transcribing
an official document that proves something

normalIntro.en: Trans- means across and script means writing, so a transcript is writing carried across from one form to another.
normalIntro.cn: trans- 意为「越过」，script 意为「写」，所以 transcript 就是「从一种形式抄写到另一种形式」的文本。

normal.en: A transcript of a course lists the grades you earned.
normal.cn: 课程的成绩单列出你获得的分数。

normal.en: An interview transcript writes down every word that was said.
normal.cn: 访谈文字稿把说过的每句话都写下来。

normal.en: Transcribe is the verb, transcription is the act or the text.
normal.cn: transcribe 是动词，transcription 是动作或成品。

normal.en: The same root gives script, describe and manuscript.
normal.cn: 同一个词根还给出 script、describe 与 manuscript。

normal.en: Compare certificate: a certificate proves a fact, a transcript lists grades.
normal.cn: 对比 certificate：证明书证明某个事实，成绩单列出各科分数。

abstract.en: Picture a clerk copying a page from one book into another.
abstract.cn: 想象书记员把一页内容从一本书抄到另一本书。

abstract.en: Picture a sealed sheet of grades sliding into an envelope.
abstract.cn: 想象一张盖章的成绩单滑进信封。

abstract.en: Picture a recorder turning sound into lines on paper.
abstract.cn: 想象录音机把声音变成纸上的一行行字。

examples.en: You must order an official transcript for each application.
examples.cn: 每份申请你都要单独申请一份官方成绩单。

examples.en: The transcript of the hearing runs to forty pages.
examples.cn: 这场听证会的记录长达四十页。

examples.en: Reporters checked the interview transcript before printing it.
examples.cn: 记者在刊印前核对了访谈文字稿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「transcript」读近「穿斯克瑞普特」——把课堂表现「穿」成文字，再盖章成成绩单；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过、越过）+ scribere（写）→ 中世纪拉丁语 transcriptum（抄写出的文本）→ 英语 transcript；核心义「抄写下来的文本」，故有成绩单、文字稿、抄本。

sensesIntro.en: Transcript begins as a copy written out from a document, then narrows to speech written down, widens to the school grade record, and is borrowed for an RNA copy.
sensesIntro.cn: transcript 先指依文件抄出的副本，再收窄为写下来的讲话，又扩大为学校成绩记录，最后被借作核糖核酸的转录本。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a page copied across, word for word, and sealed.
core.cn: 核心意象：把内容一字不差抄到另一张纸上并盖章。

branches.en: The school record is the everyday sense for applicants.
branches.cn: 学校记录是申请人最常遇到的义项。

branches.en: Speech written down extends the copy to talk.
branches.cn: 把讲话写下来，把「副本」扩展到口语。

branches.en: The document copy is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 文件副本是最古老的义项。

branches.en: The RNA copy borrows the image for biology.
branches.cn: 核糖核酸副本把这一意象借给了生物学。

branches.en: Both a grade sheet and a speech record are copied text.
branches.cn: 成绩单与讲话记录都是抄写而成的文本。

intro.en: Transcript joins Latin trans-, across, with scribere, to write; the same parts build transcribe and transcription.
intro.cn: transcript 由拉丁语 trans-（穿过）与 scribere（写）构成；同样的部件还构成 transcribe 与 transcription。

latinIntro.en: Latin trans means across and scribere means to write; transcriptum is a copy written out.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 trans 意为穿过，scribere 意为书写；transcriptum 指抄写出来的副本。

items.exampleCN: transcription 加上表示动作的后缀。

items.example: Transcribe is the verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: transcribe 是这一词族的动词。

items.example: Scribe names the person who writes.
Script is the bare writing root.
items.exampleCN: script 是「写」这一词根最直接的形式。

items.meaning: to write or tell about something
items.exampleCN: describe 由 de- 与 scribere 组合。
